title: Babysitting
hook: 爸爸妈妈晚上出门，爷爷奶奶来看孩子，结果小孩没睡，大人倒先累坏了。

cells.q: What are Mummy and Daddy Pig doing tonight?
cells.a: They are going out for the evening, so Granny will baby-sit.
cells.cn: 他们今晚要出门，由奶奶来看孩子。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig tell the children?
cells.a: She told them to go to sleep quickly.

cells.q: What did Granny Pig say about the children?
cells.a: She said Peppa and George are so good.

cells.q: What did Granny Pig ask upstairs?
cells.a: She asked, “Peppa, George? Are you awake?”
cells.cn: 她问：“佩奇、乔治？你们醒着吗？”

cells.q: What are Granny and Grandpa watching?
cells.a: They are watching a gardening programme about roses.
cells.cn: 他们在看一个讲玫瑰的园艺节目。

cells.a: They asked if they can watch TV with Granny and Grandpa.
cells.cn: 他们问能不能和爷爷奶奶一起看电视。

cells.q: What did Peppa think of the programme?
cells.a: She thought the programme was very boring.
cells.cn: 她觉得这个节目很无聊。

cells.q: What did they play with Grandpa Pig?
cells.a: They played catch, so Grandpa Pig is a bit tired.
cells.cn: 他们玩了抓人，所以猪爷爷有点累了。

cells.q: What did the parents find when they came home?
cells.a: They came back home and found the little piggies asleep.
cells.cn: 他们回到家，发现小猪们都睡着了。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: evening, baby-sit, sleep, awake, programme, tired
helper.actions: go out, sleep, watch, play, run, come back

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Babysitting”.
ending: In the end, the little piggies are asleep. My favourite part is ______.
